scheme_name: Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: One-Man Shows
other_conditions: Continuous residence in Tamil Nadu for at least 5 years
Continuous involvement in the field of painting and sculpture
Possess an adequate number of artworks for the show
Participation in National or State level Art Exhibitions and Artists Camps considered as additional qualification
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 for conducting a one‑man art exhibition.
